title: Develop a paragraph with purposeful specifics
instructions: Develop the charity-sale composition without presenting invented precision as fact. Body paragraph one shows how the initial task plan made the workload manageable. Body paragraph two shows how the same method supported adaptation after rain. Answer all six questions before viewing feedback.

parts.prompt: Which revision develops the assertion ‘The plan helped us’ most effectively?

options.text: The plan helped us because it was very helpful and useful.
The plan was amazing, wonderful and extremely organised.
Assigning deadlines to publicity, supplies, prices and staffing exposed the unconfirmed drinks order while there was still time to act.
Planning is something that many people do in many situations.

choice_rationales.A: This repeats the assertion without supplying evidence or consequence.
choice_rationales.B: Intensifying adjectives do not show what happened or why the plan mattered.
choice_rationales.C: This names the action, the discovered problem and the practical consequence.
choice_rationales.D: The general statement does not develop this paragraph's particular example.

parts.hint: Choose the revision that lets the reader identify an action and observe what changed because of it.
parts.correct_explanation: The deadline system and discovered order provide concrete, purpose-aligned evidence of improved organisation.

parts.prompt: Which THREE details purposefully support the initial-planning paragraph?

options.text: The organisers separated publicity, supplies, prices and staffing into four responsibility areas.
Each area received an owner and a deadline on the checklist.
The checklist exposed that the drinks order had not been confirmed.
A poster used orange lettering beside a small cake drawing.
Exactly 1,347 people admired the organisation, although no attendance record existed.

choice_rationales.A: This precisely identifies the planning action.
choice_rationales.B: This adds the mechanism that made responsibilities visible and checkable.
choice_rationales.C: This supplies an observable consequence of the method.
choice_rationales.D: The colour and drawing are specific but do not demonstrate manageable planning.
choice_rationales.E: The exact number is unsupported false precision.

parts.hint: Select relevant action, mechanism and consequence; reject decoration and unsupported precision.
parts.correct_explanation: The three selected details form a coherent evidence chain from task division through tracking to discovery of an unfinished responsibility.

parts.prompt: Which sentence best explains the significance of discovering the unfinished drinks order?

options.text: This was good and shows that planning is good.
This mattered because the broad worry that ‘something might be missing’ became one visible responsibility that the group could still complete.
Drinks can be sold at many different kinds of events.
The word ‘deadline’ contains eight letters.

choice_rationales.A: This labels the result positively but does not explain the mechanism or insight.
choice_rationales.B: This links the local consequence to the controlling idea of manageable decisions.
choice_rationales.C: This general fact does not explain why the discovery supports the paragraph purpose.
choice_rationales.D: This observation is irrelevant to the event and its significance.

parts.hint: Complete the ‘so what’ by connecting the concrete result to the paragraph promise.
parts.correct_explanation: The sentence explains how the method converted uncertainty into a specific action, which is the paragraph's central contribution.

parts.prompt: Which observation is the most purposeful detail for the rain-and-adaptation paragraph?

options.text: Water was spreading towards an extension lead, so the group moved electrical equipment before carrying decorations indoors.
The clouds contained several shades of grey that could be described for many sentences.
One helper's shoes had white laces and a blue stripe.
The school hall had been painted some years earlier.

choice_rationales.A: The observation creates an urgent reason for the prioritised action and shows adaptation.
choice_rationales.B: Extended cloud description would delay rather than explain the decision.
choice_rationales.C: The shoe detail has no effect on action, tension or insight.
choice_rationales.D: The paint history does not perform the paragraph's disruption-and-adaptation job.

parts.hint: Choose the observation that changes what the organisers need to do next.
parts.correct_explanation: The approaching water is selective narrative evidence: it makes the safety priority and the resulting action understandable.

parts.prompt: Which sentence should be revised because it uses false precision?

options.text: We divided the work into four task areas listed on our planning sheet.
The rain forced us to move the outdoor stalls into the hall.
All 1,347 visitors became exactly 82 per cent calmer because of our method, although we collected no attendance or survey data.
Checking one priority at a time reduced our confusion during the move.

choice_rationales.A: The bounded count describes the task structure established in the scenario.
choice_rationales.B: This states the central complication without unsupported measurement.
choice_rationales.C: The exact attendance and emotional percentage are presented without any credible source or observation.
choice_rationales.D: This is a proportionate reflection on the group's response.

parts.hint: Find the numbers that imitate authority without evidence that they were recorded.
parts.correct_explanation: Specificity must be truthful; unsupported exact statistics weaken credibility rather than strengthening development.

parts.prompt: Which development map is ready to become a focused body paragraph?

options.text: Purpose: initial planning made the work manageable. Action: divide four responsibilities and assign owners and deadlines. Consequence: expose the missing drinks order. Significance: replace vague worry with one visible next action.
Purpose: planning. Details: posters, shoes, weather, food and everything else. Significance: it was nice.
Purpose: prove guaranteed success. Evidence: invent exact visitor statistics. Significance: repeat the claim.
Purpose: initial planning. Evidence: describe only the rain complication. Consequence: start another unrelated topic.

choice_rationales.A: The action, consequence and significance all fulfil one precise paragraph purpose.
choice_rationales.B: The list confuses quantity and decoration with purposeful development.
choice_rationales.C: The overclaim and invented evidence are not credible development.
choice_rationales.D: The evidence belongs to a different paragraph job and the sequence drifts further.

parts.hint: Choose the map in which relevant, honest specifics lead to a consequence and an explained insight.
parts.correct_explanation: The complete map climbs from a controlling purpose through specific action and observable consequence to significance.
